# Feature: Content Strategy

## Overview
Implement tools and workflows to support SEO-driven content creation, optimization, and measurement across the marketing website.

## User Stories

1. Keyword Research
   - As a content strategist
   - I want to identify valuable keywords
   - So that I can create targeted content

2. Content Optimization
   - As a content writer
   - I want SEO recommendations while writing
   - So that I can optimize content effectively

3. Content Performance
   - As a marketing manager
   - I want to track content performance
   - So that I can measure ROI

4. Topic Clustering
   - As a content strategist
   - I want to organize content by topics
   - So that we build topical authority

5. Content Calendar
   - As a content manager
   - I want to plan and schedule content
   - So that we maintain consistent publishing

## Technical Tasks
- [ ] Create keyword research tools
- [ ] Implement content scoring system
- [ ] Build SEO recommendation engine
- [ ] Create content performance tracking
- [ ] Implement topic mapping
- [ ] Add editorial calendar
- [ ] Create content audit tools
- [ ] Implement competitor analysis
- [ ] Add content distribution tools
- [ ] Create reporting dashboard

## Acceptance Criteria
- Keyword research provides insights
- Content scores calculate accurately
- SEO recommendations are helpful
- Performance tracking works
- Topic clusters organize properly
- Calendar functions correctly
- Reports generate accurately
- Mobile interface works

## Technical Notes
- Use API integration for research
- Implement proper caching
- Use background jobs for analysis
- Cache performance metrics
- Follow content API standards
- Implement proper logging

## Estimate
- Story Points: 13
- Time Estimate: 1.5 weeks

## Dependencies
- Technical SEO feature
- Analytics Integration feature
